long_biography.plain_text:
At Eleventh Hour, Jeff Ganter built a recruitment practice around the particular demands of creative work. Rather than matching candidates by technical skill alone, he emphasised personality, working style and cultural fit, drawing on a network developed across themed and location-based entertainment.

Ganter widened that people-focused work into executive consulting and leadership coaching. The firm began offering direct-hire, freelance and project-based placements, alongside programmes in team development, retention and organisational change. He now also hosts The Talent Brief, using two decades of conversations with executives and jobseekers to explore leadership, career decisions and workplace behaviour.
